page: Microsoft Azure D64alds_v7 is an AMD-powered instance configured with 64 virtual central processing units and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The compute foundation utilizes an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz across 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The architecture incorporates 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, backed by vector extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16, alongside hardware cryptographic acceleration through VAES and SHA-NI.

Benchmark results place the CPU in the top tier for raw compute capacity, delivering a PassMark CPU score of 91,889.21 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 26,926.0. Memory throughput reaches 205.53 GB/sec in uncached read operations and 131.87 GB/sec in uncached writes. The virtual machine bundles 3,780 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD local storage, enabling top-tier database operation benchmarks of 36,162.17 in PassMark and 101.84 million Redis SET operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the low-memory ratio reduces hypervisor overhead costs while maintaining 64 high-frequency dedicated cores and substantial NVMe disk capacity. The tradeoff is memory capacity relative to compute density; large workloads that require memory-dense footprints will encounter limits despite the high-speed CPU and fast local scratch space.

This server type is suitable for compilation pipelines, batch data transformations, high-throughput web serving, and database workloads requiring low-latency local storage, as demonstrated by strong Clang build performance and robust multi-threaded decompression throughput.
description: Microsoft Azure D64alds_v7 is a compute-focused instance featuring 64 vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating up to 4.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with 32 physical cores and hyper-threading, it includes instruction sets such as AVX-512 and hardware encryption. The configuration includes 3,780 GB of integrated NVMe SSD local storage, delivering high I/O throughput for scratch and cache operations. Benchmark scores establish top-tier ratings in PassMark CPU compute, multi-core compilation, and database processing, alongside strong memory bandwidth. With an economical 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio, the instance trades massive memory capacity for high processing density and fast storage, making it suitable for CI/CD builds, Redis caches, batch processing, and high-concurrency web tiers.
